units: <cite ref="Sotah 47b:20">Sot. 47ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>יִנְוֶה</he>, v. <cite ref="N00316"><he>נָוֶה</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: to beautify, adorn. Y. Peah I, 15ᵇ (ref. to Ex. XV, 2) וכי … לַנְווֹת את בוראו is it possible for man to beautify his Maker?; Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 3 להַנְווֹת קונו; (Yalk. Ex. 244 להשוות לקונו, v. infra).—2) to equal, adapt one’s self to.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 133b:6">Sabb. 133ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>ואנוהו</he>, Ex. l. c.) <he>הוי דומה לו</he> be like Him; Mekh. l. c. <he>נדמה לו</he> let us be like Him. Yalk. l. c. <he>וכי … להשוות לקוני</he> is it possible for man to equal his Creator?

senses.gloss: to adorn one’s self. Mekh. l. c. אֶנָּוֶוה לפניו, v. נָאָה.
to make one’s self handsome, to be vain.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 1:8">Sot. I, 8</cite> <he>אבשלום נ׳ בשערו</he> Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. 9ᵇ <he>נתגאה</he>) Absalom was vain of his hair.

senses.gloss: to beautify. Mekh. l. c. (ref. to ואניהו, v. supra) נַיֶּינּוּ ושַׁבְּחוּ להב״ה וכ׳ beautify Him, and praise the Lord before all nations (Yalk. l. c. אגיד נאותיו ושְׁבָחוֹ וכ׳, v. נָאֶה).
